description: This file implements the 'git difftool' command as a C source file for Git, including functions to handle configuration, diff execution, and directory/file diff modes, along with internal utilities for managing symlinks, submodules, and working tree files.

classes.name: difftool_options
classes.description: Structure holding options for the difftool command, including symlink handling and trust exit code flag.

methods.name: int difftool_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Configures difftool options based on git config variables.

methods.name: int print_tool_help(void)
methods.description: Runs a child process to display available diff tools and their help information.

methods.name: int parse_index_info(struct repository * repo,char * p,int * mode1,int * mode2,struct object_id * oid1,struct object_id * oid2,char * status)
methods.description: Parses index line information for the diff, extracting modes, object IDs, and status.

methods.name: void add_path(struct strbuf * buf,size_t base_len,const char * path)
methods.description: Adds a path component to a strbuf, handling trailing slashes.

methods.name: int use_wt_file(struct repository * repo,const char * workdir,const char * name,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Determines whether a file in the working tree can be reused based on object ID and file status.

methods.name: char * get_symlink(struct repository * repo,struct difftool_options * dt_options,const struct object_id * oid,const char * path)
methods.description: Reads symlink content or object data for a given path and object ID.

methods.name: int checkout_path(unsigned mode,struct object_id * oid,const char * path,const struct checkout * state)
methods.description: Checks out an object from the object database into the working directory.

methods.name: void write_file_in_directory(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * dir,size_t dir_len,const char * path,const char * content)
methods.description: Writes content to a file within a specified directory, ensuring directories exist.

methods.name: void write_standin_files(struct repository * repo,struct pair_entry * entry,struct strbuf * ldir,size_t ldir_len,struct strbuf * rdir,size_t rdir_len)
methods.description: Writes placeholder files for submodules and symlinks to display diffs.

methods.name: int run_dir_diff(struct repository * repo,struct difftool_options * dt_options,const char * extcmd,const char * prefix,struct child_process * child)
methods.description: Executes a directory diff, preparing temporary directories, running the diff, and managing the output.

methods.name: int run_file_diff(int prompt,const char * prefix,struct child_process * child)
methods.description: Runs a file-by-file diff operation using child processes.

methods.name: int cmd_difftool(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'git difftool' command, parsing arguments, setting up environment, and invoking diff modes.
